subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh target-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, refresh one of the fork candidates, or wait for contributor follow-up?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but same-repository fixes were closed unmerged and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr plus needs-maintainer-review.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with boundary-preserving tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Choose the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new automated branch until a contributor refreshes a mergeable candidate with proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with boundary-preserving tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the implementation path.
